summary: Read select.value as the value of the first selected option or the empty string.

target.notes: Search options in tree order for the first selected option and return its option value; return empty string if none is selected.

semantics.selection_order: first selected option in tree order

caveats: Multiple selects can have several selected options but value still reports the first.

tests.name: returns selected option value
tests.input: const s=document.createElement('select'); s.innerHTML='<option value=a>A</option><option value=b selected>B</option>'; console.log(s.value);

tests.name: no selection is empty string
tests.input: const s=document.createElement('select'); s.multiple=true; s.innerHTML='<option>a</option>'; s.options[0].selected=false; console.log(s.value==='');
